name: cron
description: Schedules granted by the operator become tick events (cron expressions, @daily, @every 30s)

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the cron expressions, e.g. Europe/Berlin

schedule.description: schedule as [name=]expression, e.g. nightly=0 3 * * * or @every 5m (at most 32)

tick.description: a schedule is due: {name, schedule, scheduled, at} (milliseconds)
